title: "Sorrow of the Heavenly Eye"
next_chapter_hook: "When Chen Ji stepped into the coordinates guided by the Eye of Heavenly Dao, what awaited him was not only the final fragment of the Tianji Record— but also Ling Yuan's meticulously planned lethal trap."

text.content: "The night in the Tianqing Sect's Council Hall was longer than usual. When Ling Yuan left, that gaze still burned on Chen Ji's back, like a poisoned软刀— no blood, yet chilling to the bone. He sat cross-legged on the meditation cushion, his face wearing its usual cowardice and woodenness, but deep in his heart, his mind raced at lightning speed. A temporary alliance? Nothing more than a遮羞布 for those with hidden agendas. Ling Yuan wanted to use his hand to scout the path, but was he not also leveraging Ling Yuan's power to set the world as his chessboard? It's just that the old fox's killing intent was so undisguised, adding quite a few variables to this game. Chen Ji slowly closed his eyes, his divine sense sinking deep into the Mental Sea, where a page of yellowed fragment floated— the first page of the Tianji Record, where Mo Xiansheng's fragmented soul waited in silence."

dialogue.content: "'It has come.' Mo Xiansheng's voice emerged from the fragment, hoarse and ancient, carrying a gravity Chen Ji had never heard before. 'Three months earlier than anticipated.'\n\nThe ink on the fragment suddenly trembled violently, as if something was tearing open a rift from the endless Void, approaching this world."

text.content: "Chen Ji's brow center twitched. The Tianji Record fragment turned pages on its own, golden runes scattering like startled fireflies, sketching a colossal eye within the Mental Sea. That eye was profound as an abyss, swirling with countless visions of stars being born and dying— each frame a篡改的因果, a erased history. 'The Eye of Heavenly Dao...' Chen Ji murmured, his fingertips unconsciously tightening. He had glimpsed fragments of this eye countless times— at the edges of foresight visions, in the cracks of fate— yet never imagined it would appear in such a complete form."

dialogue.content:
"'Chen Ji.'

That voice did not come from his ear, but resounded directly within Chen Ji's divine soul— vast, ancient, as if carrying billions of years of loneliness and exhaustion.

'At last, you have reached this point.'

The pupil of the Eye of Heavenly Dao slightly contracted, and countless threads of karma shot forth from within, yet all shattered upon touching the three feet surrounding Chen Ji— that was the Tianji Record fragment automatically protecting its master."

text.content: "Chen Ji forcefully suppressed the shock in his heart, yet an appropriately timed fear appeared on his face. He knew only too well the temperament of such beings— they savor their prey's fear, like fine wine accompanying a meal. But deep within his gaze burned a fervor close to madness. The Eye of Heavenly Dao, the incarnation of Heavenly Dao's will, the legendary ultimate BOSS... If he could pull it into the chess game, the board of this world would need to be redrawn. 'Elder, visiting so late at night— do you have orders for me?' Chen Ji's voice trembled slightly, his acting so convincing even he nearly believed it."

dialogue.content:
"'You are acting.' The Eye of Heavenly Dao's voice held no fluctuation, yet carried a strange... approval? 'Interesting. The first mortal in a millennium to dare act before me.'

Those虚幻 eyes suddenly drew near, the pupil reflecting Chen Ji's figure— not his present self, but all his past from babbling infancy to this very moment, like turning the pages of a dusty ancient tome.

'Waste material? Servant? Feigning weakness to devour the strong?' The Eye of Heavenly Dao's voice suddenly carried a smile. 'Chen Xuan chose you back then— there was indeed reason for it.'"

text.content: "Chen Xuan. That name struck like thunder into the Mental Sea. Chen Ji's pupils dilated, his heart surged with tumultuous waves— Chen Xuan, the previous holder of the Tianji Record, said to have ascended ten thousand years ago. Why would his inheritance fall to this waste of a person? Mo Xiansheng's fragmented soul trembled violently, as if wishing to say something, yet forbidden from speaking by some seal. The Eye of Heavenly Dao seemed to sense this, a complex light flickering within its pupil."

dialogue.content:
"'You must have many questions.' The Eye of Heavenly Dao's voice suddenly lowered. 'But time is running out. The dimensional rift has begun corroding this world's foundations— at most three years, this realm will become Void's nourishment.'

Its pupil reflected a terrifying vision— the heavens torn asunder, endless darkness flooding through the cracks, and wherever it passed, mountains and rivers collapsed, cultivators turned to ash.

'I am not your enemy.' The Eye of Heavenly Dao revealed a fact that caught Chen Ji completely off guard. 'Quite the opposite... I am this world's guardian, and the Tianji Record in your hands is the final chess piece I have set.'"

text.content: "The Mental Sea fell into dead silence. Chen Ji's mind raced at lightning speed, piecing all fragments of information into a complete picture. The Eye of Heavenly Dao was not an enemy, but a guardian? The Tianji Record was not a curse, but a setup? Then those agonies of Heavenly Fate Value backlash, those tragedies glimpsed in foresight yet impossible to change— were they all merely sacrifices of chess pieces? This realization did not bring Chen Ji relief, but instead sparked an unprecedented chill. If even Heavenly Dao sets chess games, then what is he, Chen Ji, but a piece?"

choice.prompt: "The Eye of Heavenly Dao proposes an alliance to jointly resist the dimensional invasion. However, with ten thousand years of scheming, manipulated fates, and those irretrievable sacrifices... can you truly trust this being without any reservation?"

choices.description: "Though the Eye of Heavenly Dao's words are hard to believe, the dimensional invasion is an urgent crisis. Rather than harboring suspicions, better to use its power to break the situation first. As for later... on the chessboard, who is not a piece?"
choices.visible_reward: "Gain the Eye of Heavenly Dao's full support, unlock hidden functions of the Tianji Record"
choices.risk_hint: "If the Eye of Heavenly Dao's words are false, you will fall into endless ruin"

dialogue.content:
"'Good.' The Eye of Heavenly Dao's voice carried a trace of relief. 'You are more decisive than I anticipated.'

A golden light shot from its pupil, entering Chen Ji's brow center. In that instant, Chen Ji felt countless seals in his Mental Sea explode, the Tianji Record fragment flipped wildly, flooding out masses of runes and incantations he had never seen.

'This is...'"

text.content: "'The method to unseal the second page of the Tianji Record.' The Eye of Heavenly Dao's voice grew ethereal. 'Originally you needed to endure three more calamities to reach it, but given the current situation... I have opened a shortcut for you. Remember, the complete Tianji Record lies deepest within the Kunlun Ruins— there you will also find clues to finding Chen Nian.'"

choices.description: "Would a ten-thousand-year setup be abandoned so easily? A three-year deadline spoken so casually? The Eye of Heavenly Dao's words sound beautiful, but Chen Ji never believed in free lunches in the sky. Even if it truly is a guardian, a guardian's interests may not align with those of a chess piece."
choices.visible_cost: "Lose the Eye of Heavenly Dao's immediate support"
choices.visible_reward: "Retain independent judgment freedom, do not expose all hidden cards"
choices.risk_hint: "May miss critical timing, no one to support when dimensional invasion accelerates"

dialogue.content:
"'...Interesting.' The Eye of Heavenly Dao fell silent for a moment, a flicker of admiration passing through its pupil. 'Neither credulous nor blindly obedient. Chen Xuan was of similar temperament in his time.'

Its form slightly receded, that oppressive aura that had been crushing the breath suddenly fading away.

'Fine, I will not force you. But there is something you must know— Ling Yuan wants to kill you not only because of the Tianji Record.'"

text.content: "The Eye of Heavenly Dao's words made Chen Ji's heart tighten. Ling Yuan's killing intent had come too abruptly; though he had long been vigilant, he always assumed the other coveted the Tianji Record. But now it seemed there was something else behind this. 'If you wish to know the truth, come to the outskirts of Kunlun Ruins at midnight three days from now. I will wait there— whether you believe me or not, decide then.' The Eye of Heavenly Dao's voice gradually receded. 'Also... regarding Su Qingyao— you'd best handle that matter soon.'"

choices.description: "Trust requires a price. If the Eye of Heavenly Dao wants a chess piece like him, it must show sufficient sincerity. Chen Ji never refused cooperation, but he would set the rules clearly from the start— who leads, who cooperates, and what price the违约者 will pay."
choices.visible_cost: "May offend the Eye of Heavenly Dao"
choices.visible_reward: "Establish equal alliance, retain control over all hidden cards"
choices.risk_hint: "If conditions are too extreme, may infuriate this ancient being"

dialogue.content:
"Ripples suddenly stirred within the Mental Sea. The Eye of Heavenly Dao's pupil slightly dilated, seemingly amused by this ant-like mortal.

'Conditions?' Its voice carried a playful tone. 'The first in a millennium to dare negotiate with me. Speak.'

Chen Ji drew a deep breath, his gaze sharp as a blade: 'First, I retain final decision-making authority over all actions; second, information about unsealing the Tianji Record must be fully disclosed, no concealment; third—' his voice suddenly deepened, 'regarding my sister Chen Nian, you must give me an explanation.'"

text.content: "The Eye of Heavenly Dao fell silent. This silence was unusually prolonged, as if weighing something. After a long while, it spoke, its voice carrying a weariness Chen Ji had never heard before. 'Chen Nian... she was not taken by the Holy Sect.' The Eye of Heavenly Dao revealed a truth that plunged Chen Ji into an icy abyss. 'I arranged it. The Heavenly Fate Lock Key— only she can lock away the Tianji fluctuations within you. Otherwise, why do you think the Holy Sect could track a mortal woman for ten thousand years?' Killing intent churned in Chen Ji's pupils, his hands clenched into fists, fingernails digging deep into his palms."

"Chen Ji did not speak. The killing intent in his Mental Sea was like a刀锋 made real, stirring层层涟漪 around the Tianji Record fragment. Chen Nian— his sister, missing for years, whom he considered both his greatest weakness and his deepest debt. If the Eye of Heavenly Dao spoke truth, then this ten-thousand-year scheme, this so-called guardianship, had from the start been purchased with his beloved kin's freedom. What kind of guardianship is this? Nothing more than another form of imprisonment. 'I will remember this.' Chen Ji's voice was terrifyingly calm. 'When this matter is settled, what you owe me— I will collect it, item by item.'"

dialogue.content:
"'I await it.' The Eye of Heavenly Dao's voice was unexpectedly gentle. 'To maintain rationality in anger, to endure in humiliation... you are more suited to wield the Tianji Record than I anticipated.'

Its form began to dissolve, that colossal eye gradually becoming countless motes of light. But before completely departing, it left one final words:

'Kunlun Ruins holds more than the Tianji Record fragment. There also lies sealed Ling Yuan's true body from ten thousand years ago— what currently inhabits the Tianqing Sect's old sect master's form is merely a strand of usurping fragmented soul.'"

text.content: "The words fell, and silence returned to the Mental Sea. Chen Ji abruptly opened his eyes, finding himself still seated cross-legged in the Council Hall, as if everything just now was merely an illusion. But the faintly burning golden mark at his brow center told him— this was no dream. The Eye of Heavenly Dao, dimensional invasion, Ling Yuan's true identity... too much information needed digestion, too many chess games needed restructuring. Chen Ji slowly rose, pushing open the hall doors. In the night sky, stars and moon cast no light, the distant lights of Tianqing Sect flickering like chess pieces with uncertain fate on the board."

"'Senior Brother Chen?'\n\nA cold voice came from behind. Chen Ji didn't need to turn to know who had arrived— Su Qingyao, the woman who had come infinitely close to the truth three times, three times cleverly deflected by him. She now stood at the hall entrance, moonlight outlining her cold demeanor, yet a trace of subtle worry hidden in her eyes. 'Your spiritual energy fluctuations were quite intense just now— did something happen?' Chen Ji turned, his face wearing its usual honest smile: 'Nothing much, just lost focus during cultivation.' He brushed it off casually, but deep within calculated at lightning speed— Su Qingyao's timing was too coincidental. Coincidence, or was someone monitoring?"

choice.prompt: "Su Qingyao had clearly sensed the anomaly. As the only person who had thrice approached the truth, her intuition was not to be underestimated. Continue to deflect, or appropriately reveal some information to win her trust?"

choices.description: "No matter how clever Su Qingyao is, she is merely an Inner Disciple Senior Fellow. Things like the Eye of Heavenly Dao and dimensional invasion— knowing such things would only endanger her. Better to maintain the waste material persona, leaving her no opportunity to exploit."
choices.visible_cost: "Miss the opportunity to win over Su Qingyao"
choices.risk_hint: "Su Qingyao may become even more suspicious of you because of this"

text.content: "Chen Ji yawned, displaying an impatient annoyance at being disturbed: 'Senior Sister Su, what commotion could this waste of a cultivator possibly make? Perhaps some wild cat ran across the roof, disturbing your meditation, Senior Sister.' His tone carried a fawning flattery, the perfect image of a lazy servant roused from rest. Su Qingyao's gaze lingered on his face for a moment, seemingly searching for some crack, some flaw— yet saw only wooden stupefaction and愚钝. '...Get some rest early.' She ultimately left only these words, turning to leave. But Chen Ji noticed— as she walked through the hall doors, the corners of her lips pressed slightly together— a small gesture she only made when suspicious."

choices.description: "Su Qingyao's affection has already reached a sufficient level. It's time to let her know some truth. Having an Inner Disciple Senior Fellow as an inside informant is far safer than stumbling alone in the dark. Besides... her 'shared destiny' ability might prove invaluable."
choices.visible_cost: "Expose partial strength, may trigger chain reactions"
choices.visible_reward: "Deepen bond with Su Qingyao, gain Inner Sect intelligence support"
choices.risk_hint: "Su Qingyao may be unable to bear the truth and distance herself from you"

text.content: "Chen Ji fell silent for a moment, the honest simplicity gradually fading from his face, replaced by a rare gravity. 'Senior Sister Su, there is something I wish to tell you— but you must promise not to act rashly after hearing it.' Su Qingyao's footsteps halted. She turned, and in those cold eyes beneath the moonlight flickered surprise, then deeper scrutiny. 'Speak.' Chen Ji lowered his voice: 'The Sect Master... may not be the original Sect Master anymore.' With just this single sentence, Su Qingyao's expression drastically changed. She was an Inner Disciple Senior Fellow who had seen Ling Yuan in his youth— yet the bearing and manner of the current old Sect Master held subtle dissonances from her memory."

"Night wind brushed past the Council Hall, dispersing the brief silence. After seeing Su Qingyao off, Chen Ji stood alone beneath the hall's corridor, gazing up at the ink-black heavens. Kunlun Ruins, the complete Tianji Record, Chen Nian, Ling Yuan's true identity... all clues pointed in one direction— there lay the ultimate answer to his fate, perhaps also secrets sufficient to overturn the three realms. In three days, he would step into those ruins to reclaim what belonged to him. As for the Eye of Heavenly Dao's covenant, Su Qingyao's suspicions, Ling Yuan's killing intent... before then, he would bring all variables into his chess game."

dialogue.content:
"'Young Master.' Mo Xiansheng's fragmented soul hauntingly sounded within the Mental Sea. 'Do you truly intend to trust that old coot?'

Chen Ji gave no answer. His gaze穿透层层夜幕, as if already seeing Kunlun Ruins three days hence—那里不只有天道之眼's guidance, but also危机环伺的毒蛇. Ling Yuan would not stand by as Chen Ji grew, the Demonic Path forces represented by Ye Qing lurked with covetous eyes, and even the seemingly neutral three great sects each had their own calculations.

This was a chess game more dangerous than any before. Yet Chen Ji's lips curved slightly upward— the more dangerous the game, the sweeter the victory."

text.content:
"'Complete trust也好，保持怀疑也罢，抑或是提出条件...' Chen Ji murmured to himself, his voice融入夜风之中, '最终落子的，终究是我陈机自己。'

He turned and walked back into the hall, beginning preparations for the Kunlun journey three days hence. The Tianji Record fragment floated silently within the Mental Sea, its runes brighter than ever before— a gift left by the Eye of Heavenly Dao's departure, and also a heavy karmic debt. No matter how perilous the path ahead, Chen Ji had already made thorough preparations.

After all, he was never anyone's chess piece— he was the Chess Player himself."
